package student_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
)

const workspaceStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

const validLearningWorkspaceResponse = `{
	"schema":"student-learning-workspace.v1","context_version":3,
	"selected_path":{
		"learning_path_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"course_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"status":"ACTIVE","path_version":4,
		"items":[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","position":0,"status":"READY"}]
	}
}`

func TestClientGetsStrictLearningWorkspaceWithDedicatedTeacherToken(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, request.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+workspaceStudentID+"/learning-workspace", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "teacher-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Equal(t, "application/json", request.Header.Get("Accept"))
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(validLearningWorkspaceResponse))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := studenthttp.Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "generic-token",
		LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client(),
	}
	workspace, err := client.GetLearningWorkspace(context.Background(), workspaceStudentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(3), workspace.ContextVersion)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningWorkspaceItemReady, workspace.SelectedPath.Items[0].Status)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnLearningWorkspaceContractDriftAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name        string
		status      int
		contentType string
		body        string
	}{
		{name: "unknown field", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Replace(validLearningWorkspaceResponse, `"context_version":3`, `"context_version":3,"execution_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"`, 1)},
		{name: "missing context version", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Replace(validLearningWorkspaceResponse, `"context_version":3,`, "", 1)},
		{name: "missing item position", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Replace(validLearningWorkspaceResponse, `,"position":0`, "", 1)},
		{name: "empty selected path items", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Replace(validLearningWorkspaceResponse, `[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","position":0,"status":"READY"}]`, `[]`, 1)},
		{name: "multiple values", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: validLearningWorkspaceResponse + `{}`},
		{name: "wrong content type", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "text/plain", body: validLearningWorkspaceResponse},
		{name: "upstream failure", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, contentType: "application/json", body: `{}`},
		{name: "oversize", status: http.StatusOK, contentType: "application/json", body: strings.Repeat("x", (64<<10)+1)},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", testCase.contentType)
				writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.GetLearningWorkspace(context.Background(), workspaceStudentID)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
		})
	}
}

func TestClientPreservesSemanticWorkspaceAmbiguityForFailClosedPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(strings.Replace(validLearningWorkspaceResponse, `"position":0`, `"position":7`, 1)))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.GetLearningWorkspace(context.Background(), workspaceStudentID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	require.NotErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
}

func TestClientRejectsMissingLearningWorkspaceCredentialBeforeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: "http://student.internal"}
	_, err := client.GetLearningWorkspace(context.Background(), workspaceStudentID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
}
